_comment: The platform's wrappers around a chat row's text and what a reader shows of it. `input` is a stored user row (the interactive tailers keep the typed text whole); `stripped` is the text drawn for it, null when the row is not drawn at all (the typed copy of a worker's report, whose delegate_result row is the card). Read by the dashboard's lib/transcriptCleanup.ts (cleanUserMessageText, tests/transcriptCleanup.test.ts) and by the proxy's title stripper in storage/chat/chat_titles.py. The shapes: the delegation MCP's [DELEGATED_WORK] and [TASK_OUTPUT_DIR] blocks (mcps/custom/delegation-mcp/server.py), the result envelope (api/tasks/delegation.py _ON_COMPLETE_PROMPT) and the report-less first line (services/scheduler/lanes.missing_report_note), the Claude TUI's <pasted_content> tags around a typed paste and the [Image #N] marks it journals ahead of a paste whose photo paths it took in as images (the platform's attachments block behind the text is kept: the title alone drops it), the [Current time: …], viewer-focus, [Parallel activity — …] and concluded-meeting preludes, a leading <system-reminder> block, a slash-command record. Only a leading, closed wrapper is the platform's; a mention mid-text stays.

cases.name: the delegation wrapper ahead of a task
cases.input:
[DELEGATED_WORK]
Delegated by agent 'boss'. When you finish, your final message is delivered to that agent automatically as a report — write it as one: what you did, what you produced (with paths), and anything blocked. Do not send the caller a to-do list or questions to answer by delegation: it cannot delegate back to you and would have to re-open this lane just to reply. Put anything it must do on a single 'Blocked on:' line. Attach the files you produced with attach_result_files(paths) before your final message and name them in the report: the delegating agent receives copies in its inbox.
[/DELEGATED_WORK]

Review the plan, then report.
